title: 12 贪婪13 谈合作14 盯上
content_zh:
……
“好！”
“精彩！”
三人看到最后，忍不住叫好。
“好，我傅靖云答应了。”左手边的男子率先说道。
“我景海峰也是。”
“还有我关一涵！”
三人争先说道，凭他们多年的说书经验，这个故事绝对能火，听众的打赏绝对高。
故事抓人眼球，情节一环扣一环精彩刺激，扣人心弦！
虽然故事流传出去了，别人也可以说。
但作为第一批讲述该故事的说书人，获得关注度、吸引到的听众、获得的打赏会多很多。
老故事虽然有人听，但打赏的意愿不强。
他们大多知道了故事的结果，听书只是听个乐呵，打发时间。
新故事就不同了，剧情吸引人的故事，听众会为了想要听到接下来的故事打赏。
“那么欢迎三位先生加入，你们也可以推荐其他说书先生来找我，每推荐成功一人，我可以给你们30文钱。”
林哲羽笑着说道，接过三人的钱币。
这样一来，林哲羽每天就多出了两百四十文钱的收入，若是发展的下线更多，收入更喜人。
……
松宜城，城中一角。
“小林先生又开新篇了，是一个关于武者的故事，太精彩了！”

“粗俗的武夫的故事？能有啥精彩的？”
“就是，就是，我还是更喜欢书生故事，各种狐媚艳遇，光想想就刺激。”
一名长相略猥琐的男子附和道。
“那些有什么意思，战争与鲜血、拳拳到肉的战斗，路见不平一声吼，心有不平把刀砍，这才是男子汉大丈夫该过的生活。”
“……”
“周哥，他们在说什么，我怎么听不懂？”坐在一旁的瘦猴子疑惑道。
他是白山街区来到内城找活的。
“他们在说碧丹茶楼小林先生的事。”
“小林先生是松宜城最近出道的说书人，说书故事可精彩了，大街小巷都能够听到零零散散的谈论。”
“我也很喜欢听他说书，可惜要干活挣钱，不能常去。”
周伟成笑着说道，他也是林哲羽的说书迷。
“说书先生？小林先生？”瘦猴子好奇道：“周哥，这個小林先生全名叫什么？”
“好像是叫林哲羽来着，是个年轻书生。”
“林哲羽！”
瘦猴子眼睛一亮。
……
content_en:
…
"Okay!"
“Wonderful!”
The three of them couldn't help but cheer when they saw the end.
"Okay, I, Fu Jingyun, agree." The man on the left said first.
"Me, Jing Haifeng, too."
"And I, Guan Yihan!"
The three of them rushed to say that based on their many years of storytelling experience, this story would definitely be popular and the rewards from the audience would definitely be high.
The story is eye-catching, and the plot is exciting and exciting!
Although the story has spread, others can tell it.
But as the first storytellers to tell the story, they will gain much more attention, attract more listeners, and receive much more rewards.
Although some people listen to old stories, they are not very willing to reward them.
Most of them knew the outcome of the story and listened to the book just for fun and to pass the time.
New stories are different. If the plot is attractive, the audience will reward it because they want to hear the next story.
"Then welcome these three gentlemen to join. You can also recommend other storytellers to come to me. For each successful recommendation, I can give you 30 coins."
Lin Zheyu said with a smile and took the coins from the three people.
In this way, Lin Zheyu earned an extra two hundred and forty cents per day. If he develops more offline, the income will be even more gratifying.
…
Songyi City, a corner of the city.
"Mr. Xiaolin has opened a new chapter. It's a story about warriors. It's so exciting!"
"A story about a vulgar martial artist? What could be more exciting?"
"That's right, that's right, I still prefer scholar's stories, all kinds of flirtatious encounters, it's exciting just thinking about it."
A slightly wretched-looking man echoed.
"What's the meaning of war and blood, fist-to-flesh fights, roaring when you see injustice on the road, and cutting with a knife when you feel unjust? This is the life a man should live."
"..."
"Brother Zhou, why can't I understand what they are saying?" The thin monkey sitting next to him asked doubtfully.
He came to the inner city from Baishan neighborhood to look for work.
"They are talking about Mr. Kobayashi of Bitan Teahouse."
"Mr. Xiaolin is a storyteller who recently debuted in Songyicheng. The stories he tells are so exciting that you can hear scattered conversations in the streets and alleys."
"I also like to listen to his stories, but it's a pity that I have to work to make money, so I can't go there often."
Zhou Weicheng said with a smile that he is also a fan of Lin Zheyu's storytellers.
"Mr. Storyteller? Mr. Xiao Lin?" Thin Monkey asked curiously: "Brother Zhou, what is the full name of Mr. Xiao Lin?"
"It seems his name is Lin Zheyu, a young scholar."
"Lin Zheyu!"
The skinny monkey's eyes lit up.
